Class GtCsvExportDefs.Labels

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.exportcsv.GtCsvExportDefs.Labels
Enclosing class:
GtCsvExportDefs
public static final class GtCsvExportDefs.Labels extends Object
Immutable per language label set: the 16 column headers in file order plus the 8 transaction type words. The header texts are the import template's column mapping keys and must stay unique within one label set.
